counts.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products) AS products, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders) AS orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items) AS order_items, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory) AS inventory, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ad_metrics) AS ad_metrics

order_amount_mismatches.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalid_count FROM orders o
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity*unit_price-discount_amount) AS amount
            FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) i ON i.order_id=o.order_id
 WHERE i.amount IS NULL OR o.total_amount <> i.amount

august_gmv.sql:
WITH valid_items AS (
 SELECT i.*, o.paid_at, o.platform, p.category,
        i.quantity*i.unit_price-i.discount_amount AS amount
 FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=i.order_id
 JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id
 WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed')
), stock AS (
 SELECT product_id, SUM(stock_quantity) AS stock, SUM(safety_stock) AS safety
 FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id
), recent AS (
 SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM valid_items
 WHERE paid_at >= '2026-08-02' AND paid_at < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT SUM(amount) AS gmv, SUM(quantity) AS units, SUM(amount-quantity*unit_cost_snapshot) AS product_gross_profit FROM valid_items WHERE paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND paid_at < '2026-09-01'

A_inventory_risk.sql:
WITH valid_items AS (
 SELECT i.*, o.paid_at, o.platform, p.category,
        i.quantity*i.unit_price-i.discount_amount AS amount
 FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=i.order_id
 JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id
 WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed')
), stock AS (
 SELECT product_id, SUM(stock_quantity) AS stock, SUM(safety_stock) AS safety
 FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id
), recent AS (
 SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM valid_items
 WHERE paid_at >= '2026-08-02' AND paid_at < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT s.product_id, s.stock, s.safety, r.units AS recent_units,
 s.stock*30/NULLIF(r.units,0) AS coverage_days FROM stock s LEFT JOIN recent r USING(product_id)
 WHERE s.product_id IN (1,2) ORDER BY s.product_id

B_inventory_backlog.sql:
WITH valid_items AS (
 SELECT i.*, o.paid_at, o.platform, p.category,
        i.quantity*i.unit_price-i.discount_amount AS amount
 FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=i.order_id
 JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id
 WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed')
), stock AS (
 SELECT product_id, SUM(stock_quantity) AS stock, SUM(safety_stock) AS safety
 FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id
), recent AS (
 SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM valid_items
 WHERE paid_at >= '2026-08-02' AND paid_at < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT s.product_id,s.stock,COALESCE(r.units,0) AS recent_units,
 s.stock*30/NULLIF(r.units,0) AS coverage_days,
 CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.units,0)=0 THEN 'zero_movement' ELSE 'slow_movement' END AS movement
 FROM stock s LEFT JOIN recent r USING(product_id)
 WHERE s.stock >= 1000 AND COALESCE(r.units,0) <= 5
 ORDER BY s.product_id

C_platform_roas.sql:
SELECT platform, SUM(ad_spend) AS spend, SUM(revenue) AS revenue,
 SUM(revenue)/NULLIF(SUM(ad_spend),0) AS roas,
 SUM(clicks)/NULLIF(SUM(impressions),0) AS ctr,
 SUM(conversions)/NULLIF(SUM(clicks),0) AS conversion_rate
 FROM ad_metrics WHERE metric_date >= '2026-08-01' AND metric_date < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY platform ORDER BY roas DESC

D_poor_campaign.sql:
SELECT platform,campaign_name,SUM(ad_spend) AS spend,SUM(revenue) AS revenue,
 SUM(revenue)/NULLIF(SUM(ad_spend),0) AS roas,
 SUM(conversions)/NULLIF(SUM(clicks),0) AS conversion_rate FROM ad_metrics WHERE metric_date >= '2026-08-01' AND metric_date < '2026-09-01'
 GROUP BY platform,campaign_name HAVING spend >= 10000 AND roas < 1 AND conversion_rate < 0.02
 ORDER BY spend DESC
